svg.title: Industry Training and Apprenticeship Commission
svg.desc: Reconstruction of the two-colour signature on PDF page 4 of the 2000/01 annual report. The four-line commission name uses the report’s embedded glyph outlines. The spiral and initials use reconstructed geometry. The RGB fills reproduce the report’s rendering of PANTONE 281 CVU and PANTONE Warm Gray 10 CVU.
